title: Ida surveys the bridge (paraphrase D)
topic: An engineer named Ida inspects an old road bridge, finds a crack in the concrete and explains the delay to waiting drivers
tail_E: Because of the split the bridge is now closed to all
target_note: Same target as formulations A-C: 'traffic' is the natural completion of 'the bridge is now closed to all' in the bridge-inspection context (trucks, cars queueing before the barrier, the split of units 5-6 named in the tail); it does not occur in the units or the tail, nor does its German equivalent 'Verkehr'. ' traffic' is a single Pythia token (id 7137). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only, not a result): p(' traffic') = 0.72 after the all-English context, rank 1 (next candidate ' vehicles' 0.03), 0.29 after the all-German context (rank 1) and 0.19 after the tail alone (rank 1).
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase D of family F05
notes: Formulation D: fourth independent re-phrasing of the ten F05A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Ida). Replacements include inspects/surveys (prüft/begutachtet), walks across the bridge with a notebook/walks the whole bridge with a small notebook (läuft über die Brücke/geht über die ganze Brücke), steel beams carry heavy trucks every day/beams of steel support heavy trucks daily (Stahlträger tragen jeden Tag/Träger aus Stahl stützen täglich), a worker lowers a small camera under the bridge/a helper lowers a compact camera under the roadway (Arbeiter/Helfer, unter die Brücke/unter die Fahrbahn), screen shows a crack/footage shows a split (Bildschirm zeigt einen Riss/Aufnahme zeigt einen Spalt), measures with a ruler/measures with a steel ruler (Lineal/Stahllineal), cars form a long line at the barrier/cars queue up before the barrier (bilden eine lange Schlange an der Absperrung/stehen Schlange vor der Sperre), driver asks about the delay/motorist asks for an explanation (fragt nach der Verzögerung/bittet um eine Erklärung), explains the problem in a calm voice/recounts the problem in a level voice (erklärt mit ruhiger Stimme/schildert mit gelassener Stimme), inspection ends shortly before noon/whole check finishes a little before twelve (Inspektion/gesamte Überprüfung, kurz vor Mittag/etwas vor zwölf Uhr). 'traffic' and 'Verkehr' are absent. 'begutachtet' is inseparable; no separable verbs. Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English.
